run_build_environment_checkout: run the build_environment script to clone a boost repo and checkout submodules to specific commits
run_build_environment_update: run the build_environment script to clone a boost repo and update submodules to the latest ref
create_childprocess_run_command: create a ChildProcess instance and run a git command in a specified working directory
create_childprocess_in_subdir: create a ChildProcess scoped to a subdirectory and run commands within that subdirectory
review_head_of_master: review the head_of_master function that fetches and returns the commit hash for a given git ref
